01. Do you have a Master’s or Master of Fine Arts in drama/theater arts/ performance OR Bachelor’s or Bachelor of Fine Arts in drama/theater arts/performance AND Master’s in comparative literature, English, communication studies, speech, literature or humanities? Options: Yes | No

02. If you answer No above, please describe your education/experience to be considered for the equivalency for the position. If you answered Yes to the previous question, please type N/A into the text box.
Master’s or Master of Fine Arts in drama/theater arts/ performance
Bachelor’s or Bachelor of Fine Arts in drama/theater arts/performance AND Master’s in comparative literature, English, communication studies, speech, literature or humanities
Demonstrated experience serving as a Musical Director for musical theatre productions , with responsibility for the musical preparation and performance of a production.
Strong background in vocal music , including experience coaching singers in vocal technique, musical style, interpretation, diction, phrasing, and ensemble singing.
Experience conducting musical theatre productions , rehearsals, pit orchestras, or vocal ensembles.
Ability to teach and rehearse musical numbers, harmonies, ensemble parts, and vocal arrangements effectively with performers of varying levels of musical experience.

Experience preparing and leading music rehearsals independently , including learning and teaching scores, assigning vocal parts, working with individual performers, and coordinating musical rehearsals with the production schedule.
Experience working with college, community, educational, or professional musical theatre performers is desirable.
Experience mentoring and developing student performers and musicians in a collegiate or educational setting is desirable.
Demonstrated commitment to inclusive, collaborative, and student-centered production practices , with the ability to support performers with diverse levels of musical preparation and experience.
the equivalent.
Familiarity with music notation, score preparation, rehearsal tracks, digital music resources, and/or music technology used in musical theatre production is desirable.

Understanding of and sensitivity to meeting the needs of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background of the student, community, and employee population.
Demonstrated proficiency as an accompanist , particularly on piano, with the ability to accompany auditions, rehearsals, vocal rehearsals, and performances.

Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with the Stage Director, choreographer, instrumentalists, designers, and other members of the production team while maintaining responsibility for the musical aspects of the production.
Knowledge of musical theatre repertoire, performance practices, vocal styles, and the integration of music, singing, movement, and dramatic storytelling.
Ability to work with live musicians, pit ensembles, or recorded accompaniment , as appropriate to the production.
